artifacts.purpose: Observed empty legacy run, worktree, snapshot or holdout container.
artifacts.schema: Empty ordinary directory; child files are deliberately not classified by this entry.

artifacts.consumer_or_final_deliverable: Operator review of historical target and recovery obligations; no current file reader was established.

This exact path protects a replacement file as well as its observed empty container, grants no ownership to child files, and permits no new execution writes or copies.
